evidence: The usability audit found a second gap: the subject endpoint resolves **all sampled keys** (40/40 nodes, 40/40 edges) but **no labels**
metric: 40/40 node ids; 40/40 edge ids; 0/3 labels (EGFR, Epidermal growth factor receptor, non-small cell lung carcinoma)
observation: A coverage audit sampled node and edge identifiers from the core export and queried the running console. Every sampled key resolved, but the three label queries a non-expert would type all failed, so label resolution is a separate usability gap from the missing input.
subject: F-78
title: Subject endpoint resolves exact keys but no labels
